items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Stanley is addressed as the listener throughout the transcript (e.g., 'see, Stanley', 'than to have it laying up to today and it wouldn't be known, Stanley'), but the interviewee never describes a personal or professional relationship with him, only narrating events to him.

ctx.x: Yeah. But, otherwise, Stanley, when I was in Kansas City, there's something missing, because that was about a year or six months ago I was with Chauncy Don's Rinky Dinks. That was about the next best band in Kansas City.
